title.value: Horizontal gene transfer and recombination analysis of SARS-CoV-2 genes helps discover its close relatives and shed light on its origin
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus of the paper on the analysis of horizontal gene transfer and recombination in SARS-CoV-2 genes.
title.quote: Horizontal gene transfer and recombination analysis of SARS-CoV-2 genes helps discover its close relatives and shed light on its origin

analysis.description: This research paper explores the evolutionary patterns and origins of SARS-CoV-2 by analyzing horizontal gene transfer and recombination among its genes and those of related coronaviruses. The study identifies potential gene transfer events that suggest a recombination origin involving bat and pangolin coronavirus strains.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical methods like SimPlot similarity analysis, Φ-test recombination analysis, and horizontal gene transfer detection to analyze genetic recombination events, which are experimental methodologies.
type.quote: We conducted a detailed list of statistically significant horizontal gene transfer and recombination events inferred for each of 11 main genes of the SARS-Cov-2 genome.

name.justification: The research focuses on the genetic evolution and origins of SARS-CoV-2, which falls under the field of virology.
name.quote: The results of our horizontal gene transfer and recombination analysis suggest that SARS-Cov-2 could not only be a chimera resulting from recombination of the bat RaTG13 and Guangdong pangolin coronaviruses but also a close relative of the bat CoV ZC45 and ZXC21 strains.

name.justification: The study deeply analyzes genetic sequences and evolutionary relationships, which is a key focus in genomics.
name.quote: ...analyze the evolutionary patterns of 11 main genes of SARS-CoV-2...

name.justification: The paper employs phylogenetic analysis to study the evolutionary origins of the SARS-CoV-2.
name.quote: Topology-based clustering of gene trees inferred for 25 CoV organisms revealed a three-way evolution of coronavirus genes.

name.justification: The paper mentions the use of SimPlot for sequence similarity analysis, which is a critical step in their study.
name.quote: We first carried out the SimPlot (Lole et al. 1999) similarity analysis of coronaviruses most closely related to SARS-CoV-2...
